prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for sign_in reorder, home redesign, and finish hint changes because each kind of change has only one test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tested changes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, hint: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -2.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop habitat selection screen: Add a new desktop habitat theme picker screen right before final intro screen. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and takes a median 395s; customizing the pet's initial desktop environment increases user setup completion.)
1: [home, hint] Background generation wait hint: Add an explicit status hint reassuring users that pet graphics are rendering in the background. (why: Home step waiting time is extremely high (median 201s, mean 2336s) and 3 support emails reported confusion over pets not showing up on desktop.)
2: [sign_in, copy] One-click sign in copy tweak: Simplify sign-in headline and body copy to highlight instant one-click authentication. (why: 8 support emails mentioned lost or reset pets after signing in again; clearer single-account sign-in copy prevents duplicate account creation.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Photo upload quality checker widget: Add a photo clarity checker preview component with upload tips on the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or weird visual glitches caused by bad photo uploads.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop ready tray notification: Enable ready notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when generation finishes. (why: Home wait time has a huge mean of 2336s, indicating users minimize the app while waiting and forget about it.)

scores.note: Adding a new screen increases friction on an already low-converting finish step without support mail backing.
High wait time in home step backed by 3 support emails; simple config hint reduces drop-off.
Strong support mail evidence (8 emails) and low cost text change.
Targeting adoption step which has highest drop (39.1% loss) supported by 3 mail reports, but requires code release.
Extremely high mean time (2336s) indicates users forget background rendering; tray notifications bring users back.
